name: com.morereply/morereply
title: Morereply
description: Search public Morereply polls and read their results and published demographic analyses.

tools.name: get_analysis
tools.description: Get one published Morereply analysis by its share token, its page URL (https://morereply.com/poll/{id}/stats/{token}) or a short link. Returns each demographic group's filter, voter count and option percentages, as stored when the author published it.

analysis.description: Analysis share token, analysis page URL, or morereply.com/p/ short link

tools.name: get_poll
tools.description: Get one public Morereply poll by its id, its page URL (https://morereply.com/poll/{id}) or a short link (https://morereply.com/p/{code}). Returns the question, options, status, dates, total votes, and per-option votes and percentages when the poll shows results to visitors. A poll set to show results after close, or after voting, returns no per-option numbers until it closes.

poll.description: Poll id (UUID), poll page URL, or morereply.com/p/ short link

tools.name: list_analyses
tools.description: List published analyses: saved breakdowns of a poll's result by demographic groups (age, gender, education, country and more). Give a poll id or URL to list that poll's analyses, or leave it out for the most recent ones. Use get_analysis to read one.

poll.description: Poll id or URL. Leave out to list the most recent analyses across Morereply

language.description: Without poll: rank analyses of polls in this ISO 639-1 language first

limit.description: How many analyses to return, 1 to 20

tools.name: search_polls
tools.description: Search public Morereply polls by words in the question or options, or by author username (@name). Returns up to 20 polls with status, vote totals and, where visitors may see them, option percentages. Only polls that are voting or closed are searchable. Use get_poll for one poll's full detail.

query.description: Words to find in poll questions or options, or @username for an author's polls

language.description: Only polls written in this ISO 639-1 language, e.g. en, es, fr, pt

status.description: Only polls in this state: voting (open) or closed

limit.description: How many polls to return, 1 to 20
